earth_form.text_zh: 当此牌命中时，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
earth_form.text_en: When this hits, create an Embodiment of Earth token.

earthlore_bounty.text_zh:
每当你因行动牌效果抽1张或更多牌时，创造等量的地震涌动衍生物。
淬炼
earthlore_bounty.text_en:
Whenever you draw 1 or more cards from an action card effect, create that many Seismic Surge tokens.
Temper

earthlore_empowerment.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合使用的下一张守护者攻击行动牌费用减少1点资源并获得+5力量。
earthlore_empowerment.text_en: At the start of your turn, destroy this, then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn costs {r} less to play and gets +5{p}.

earthlore_surge.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+5力量。
再动
earthlore_surge.text_en:
The next attack action card you play this turn gains +5{p}.
Go again

earths_embrace.text_zh:
再动
在你的结束阶段开始时，创造一个大地化身衍生物。然后，若本回合你尚未放逐过一张大地牌，摧毁此牌。
earths_embrace.text_en:
Go again
At the beginning of your end phase, create an Embodiment of Earth token. Then, if you haven't banished an Earth card this turn, destroy this.

ebbing_arcstride.type_zh: 闪电 幻术师 行动·攻击
ebbing_arcstride.text_zh:
每当此牌碎片化时，它获得再动。
碎片
ebbing_arcstride.text_en:
Whenever this fragments, it gets go again.
Fragment

ebon_fold.text_zh:
瞬间——支付1点资源，摧毁乌檀折扇：放逐你手牌中的一张牌。若其为暗影牌，抽一张牌。
法力虚空2
ebon_fold.text_en:
Instant - {r}, destroy Ebon Fold: Banish a card from your hand. If it's a Shadow card, draw a card.
Spellvoid 2

echo_casque.text_zh:
每当你捶胸时，你可以支付1点资源并摧毁此牌。若如此做，抽一张牌。
战痕
echo_casque.text_en:
Whenever you beat chest, you may {r} and destroy this. If you do, draw a card.
Battleworn

echoflash.type_zh: 闪电 法师 瞬间
echoflash.text_zh:
对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
当此牌从任何区域被置入你的坟场时，你的英雄对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
echoflash.text_en:
Deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.
When this is put into your graveyard from anywhere, your hero deals 1 arcane damage to target hero.

eclectic_magnetism.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，本链环中你可以将一张非攻击行动牌当作瞬间使用。
eclectic_magnetism.text_en: When this attacks, you may play a non-attack action card this chain link as though it were an instant.

eclipse.text_zh:
传奇查恩专精
仅当本回合你使用过6张或更多具有血债的牌时才能使用日蚀。若你使用过，你可以从你的放逐区使用日蚀。
创造一个灵魂收割者·乌苏尔衍生物。
eclipse.text_en:
Legendary Chane Specialization
Play Eclipse only if you have played 6 or more cards with blood debt this turn. If you have, you may play Eclipse from your banished zone.
Create an Ursur, the Soul Reaper token.

eclipse_existence.text_zh:
直到回合结束，每当攻击命中光英雄时，你可以放逐其灵魂中的一张牌。若该英雄如此做，其失去1点生命。
若你的生命高于一位对手光英雄，你可以放逐你坟场中的一张行动牌。
eclipse_existence.text_en:
Until end of turn, whenever an attack hits a Light hero, you may banish a card from their soul. If they do, they lose 1{h}.
If you have more {h} than an opposing Light hero, you may banish an action card from your graveyard.

edge_ahead.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次战士攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以与该英雄以一个敏捷衍生物下注。”
再动
edge_ahead.text_en:
Your next Warrior attack this turn gets +3{p} and "When this attacks a hero, you may wager an Agility token with them."
Go again

edge_laden_plate.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：获得1点资源。仅当本回合你磨砺过一把剑时才能启动此异能。
战痕
edge_laden_plate.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Gain {r}. Activate this only if you've sharpened a sword this turn.
Battleworn

edge_of_autumn.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击。再动
edge_of_autumn.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack. Go again

edge_of_their_seats.text_zh:
悬念
当此牌离开竞技场时，你本回合的下一次攻击获得+5力量。
edge_of_their_seats.text_en:
Suspense
When this leaves the arena, your next attack this turn gets +5{p}.

edict_of_steel.text_zh:
磨砺你控制的目标剑。
若其上有1个或更多+1力量指示物，创造一个连击衍生物。
再动
edict_of_steel.text_en:
Sharpen target sword you control.
If it has 1 or more +1{p} counters, create a Flurry token.
Go again

eirinas_prayer.text_zh: 展示你牌库顶的一张牌。防止本回合接下来将对你的英雄造成的X点秘法伤害，X为6减去以此方式展示的牌的资源数值。
eirinas_prayer.text_en: Reveal the top card of your deck. Prevent the next X arcane damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn, where X is 6 minus the pitch value of the card revealed this way.

electrify.text_zh:
本回合攻击行动牌下一次命中英雄时，对其造成3点伤害。
若通电是从军械库使用的，抽一张牌。
再动
electrify.text_en:
The next time an attack action card hits a hero this turn, it deals 3 damage to them.
If Electrify is played from arsenal, draw a card.
Go again

electromagnetic_somersault.text_zh: 选择当前链环上至多2张费用为2或更高的攻击行动牌。当链环结算时，将它们移回其拥有者的手牌。
electromagnetic_somersault.text_en: Choose up to 2 attack action cards with cost 2 or more on the active chain link. Return them to their owner's hand when the chain link resolves.

electrostatic_discharge.text_zh: 本回合你使用的下一张费用为1或更低的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
electrostatic_discharge.text_en: The next attack action card you play this turn with cost 1 or less gets +3{p}.

electryn_joltstep.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动
electryn_joltstep.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次符文剑士或闪电攻击获得+3力量。
创造一个闪电流转衍生物。
再动
electryn_joltstep.text_en:
Your next Runeblade or Lightning attack this turn gets +3{p}.
Create a Lightning Flow token.
Go again

electryn_mindmeld.name_zh: 艾雷克特里恩·心灵融合
electryn_mindmeld.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
electryn_mindmeld.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得+1力量，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，对其造成1点秘法伤害。”
此牌第一次对英雄造成伤害时，你可以将你坟场中的一张瞬间牌置于你的牌库底。
electryn_mindmeld.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets +1{p} and "When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them."
The first time this deals damage to a hero, you may put an instant card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.

elemental_strike.text_zh: 作为使用此牌的额外费用，放逐你手牌中的一张牌。若其为大地牌，此牌获得+2力量。闪电牌，此牌获得再动。冰牌，此牌获得支配。
elemental_strike.text_en: As an additional cost to play this, banish a card from your hand. If it's Earth, this gets +2{p}. Lightning, this gets go again. Ice, this gets dominate.

elliptical_conflux.type_zh: 闪电 幻术师 瞬间·光环
elliptical_conflux.text_zh:
当此牌离开竞技场时，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
结界2
elliptical_conflux.text_en:
When this leaves the arena, create an Embodiment of Lightning token.
Ward 2

eloquence.text_zh: 当你使用非攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌，该牌获得再动。
eloquence.text_en: When you play a non-attack action card, destroy this and the card gets go again.

eloquent_eulogy.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
eloquent_eulogy.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，若本回合有英雄失去过生命，创造一个雄辩衍生物。
血债
eloquent_eulogy.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, if a hero has lost {h} this turn, create an Eloquence token.

将你坟场中一张具有血债的攻击行动牌置于你的牌库底。
血债
embalm.text_en:
You may play this from your banished zone. If you do, it gets go again.
Put an attack action card with blood debt from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.
Blood Debt

embermaw_cenipai.text_zh:
虚击
当烬口之蜃被摧毁时，创造一个灰烬衍生物。
embermaw_cenipai.text_en:
Phantasm
When Embermaw Cenipai is destroyed, create an Ash token.

embodiment_of_earth.text_zh:
防御时你控制的“非攻击”行动牌获得+1防御。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁大地化身。
embodiment_of_earth.text_en:
'Non-attack' action cards you control have +1{d} while defending.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Embodiment of Earth.

embodiment_of_lightning.text_zh: 当你使用攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌，然后该攻击获得再动。
embodiment_of_lightning.text_en: When you play an attack action card, destroy this, then the attack gets go again.

embody_greatness.text_zh:
希亚娜专精
说出一位在世传奇英雄的名字。直到你的下一个回合开始，你成为该英雄，但你的基础生命不变。
embody_greatness.text_en:
Shiyana Specialization
Name a living legend hero. Become that hero until the start of your next turn, except your base {h} doesn't change.

embolden.text_zh:
再动
当此牌进入竞技场时，若你控制另一个非衍生物光环，抽一张牌。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合使用的下一张守护者攻击行动牌获得+5力量。
embolden.text_en:
Go again
When this enters the arena, if you control another non-token aura, draw a card.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn gets +5{p}.

emboldened_blade.text_zh:
将任意军械库中的一张牌面朝下的牌翻为正面朝上。若其为防御反应，摧毁它，你本回合的下一次武器攻击获得+1力量。
再动
emboldened_blade.text_en:
Turn a face-down card in any arsenal face-up. If it's a defense reaction, destroy it and your next weapon attack this turn gets +1{p}.
Go again

emboldened_by_the_crowd.text_zh: 若本回合你被欢呼过，此牌的使用费用减少3点资源。
emboldened_by_the_crowd.text_en: If you've been cheered this turn, this costs {r}{r}{r} less to play.

embrace_adversity.text_zh:
仅当攻击的操控者本回合摧毁过一个力量衍生物时，此牌才能防御该攻击。

This may only defend an attack if the attack's controller has destroyed a Might token this turn.

若此牌将从任何区域置入你的坟场，改为放逐它。

embraforged_gauntlet.text_en:
If this would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, instead banish it.
Temper
Blood Debt

emerging_avalanche.type_zh: 元素 守护者 行动·光环
emerging_avalanche.text_zh:
冰融合
再动
当骤起的雪崩进入竞技场时，若它已融合，在目标英雄的控制下创造一个霜咬衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁骤起的雪崩，然后你本回合使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
emerging_avalanche.text_en:
Ice Fusion
Go again
When Emerging Avalanche enters the arena, if it was fused, create a Frostbite token under target hero control.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Emerging Avalanche then the next attack action card you play this turn gains +3{p}.

emerging_dominance.text_zh: 在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁骤起的支配，然后你本回合使用的下一张守护者攻击行动牌获得+3力量和支配。
emerging_dominance.text_en: At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Emerging Dominance then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn gains +3{p} and dominate.

emerging_power.text_zh:
再动
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合使用的下一张守护者攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
emerging_power.text_en:
Go again
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p}.

emeritus_scolding.text_en: Deal 4 arcane damage to target hero. If Emeritus Scolding is played during an opponents turn, instead deal 6 arcane damage to them.

emissary_of_moon.text_en: When this attacks, you may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card.

emissary_of_tides.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以将手牌中的一张牌置于牌库底。若如此做，此牌获得+2力量。
emissary_of_tides.text_en: When this attacks, you may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, this gets +2{p}.

emissary_of_wind.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以将手牌中的一张牌置于牌库底。若如此做，此牌获得再动。
emissary_of_wind.text_en: When this attacks, you may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, this gets go again.

emperor_dracai_of_aesir.text_zh:
你的牌库中只能有红色牌。
行动——支付3点资源：从你的牌库中搜寻指挥与征服，用它攻击，然后洗牌。
emperor_dracai_of_aesir.text_en:
You may only have red cards in your deck.
Action - {r}{r}{r}: Search your deck for Command and Conquer, attack with it, then shuffle.

empowering_ruckus.text_zh: 若本回合你被欢呼过，此牌获得+1力量。
empowering_ruckus.text_en: If you've been cheered this turn, this gets +1{p}.

empyrean_rapture.type_zh: 光 幻术师 装备·胸部
empyrean_rapture.text_zh:
若本回合有名称中含有先驱者的牌被置入你的英雄的灵魂，本回合你启动的第一个英雄异能费用减少2点资源。
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源：此牌直到回合结束获得结界1。
empyrean_rapture.text_en:
If a card with Herald in its name has been put into your hero's soul during your turn, the first hero ability you activate that turn costs {r}{r} less to activate.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}: This gets ward 1 until end of turn.

en_garde.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次武器攻击获得+3力量。
再动
en_garde.text_en:
Your next weapon attack this turn gains +3{p}.
Go again

enact_vengeance.text_en: Combo - If Edge of Autumn or a card with Vengeance in its name was the last attack this combat chain, this gets "When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal."

encase.type_zh: 元素 法师 行动
encase.text_zh:
冰融合
对任意目标造成3点秘法伤害。若冰封已融合并对英雄造成伤害，冻结该英雄及其控制的所有装备，直到你的下一个回合开始。
encase.text_en:
Ice Fusion
Deal 3 arcane damage to any target. If Encase was fused and deals damage to a hero, freeze that hero and all equipment they control until the start of your next turn.

enchanted_quiver.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点秘法伤害。若你军械库中有一张正面朝上的箭矢，改为防止接下来的2点。
enchanted_quiver.text_en: Instant - Destroy this: Prevent the next 1 arcane damage that would be dealt to you this turn. If there is a face-up arrow in your arsenal, instead prevent the next 2.

enchanting_melody.text_zh:
再动
若你的英雄将受到伤害，改为摧毁迷人旋律并防止该来源将造成的4点伤害。
在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁迷人旋律，除非本回合你使用过一张“非攻击”行动牌。
enchanting_melody.text_en:
Go again
If your hero would be dealt damage, instead destroy Enchanting Melody and prevent 4 damage that source would deal.
At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Enchanting Melody unless you have played a 'non-attack' action card this turn.

encore.text_zh:
将你坟场中的一张吟游诗人攻击行动牌移回你的手牌。
再动
encore.text_en:
Return a Bard attack action card from your graveyard to your hand.
Go again

endear_devotion.type_zh: 龙裔 战士 攻击反应
endear_devotion.text_zh: 目标匕首攻击获得+3力量。若你控制两个或更多龙裔链环，创造一个效忠衍生物。
endear_devotion.text_en: Target dagger attack gets +3{p}. If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, create a Fealty token.

endless_arrow.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
endless_arrow.text_zh: 当此牌命中时，将其置入其拥有者的手牌。
endless_arrow.text_en: When this hits, put it into its owner's hand.

endless_maw.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
endless_maw.text_zh:
作为使用无尽巨口的额外费用，随机放逐你坟场中的3张牌。
若以此方式放逐的是一张力量为6或更高的牌，无尽巨口获得+3力量。
血债
endless_maw.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Endless Maw, banish 3 random cards from your graveyard.
If a card with 6 or more {p} is banished this way, Endless maw gains +3{p}.
Blood Debt

endless_winter.type_zh: 元素 守护者 行动·攻击
endless_winter.text_zh:
奥德希姆专精
冰融合
若无尽寒冬已融合，每当防御英雄向此链环加入防御牌时，在其控制下创造一个霜咬衍生物。
若无尽寒冬命中英雄，直到其下一个回合结束，每当其启动异能时，在其控制下创造一个霜咬衍生物。
endless_winter.text_en:
Oldhim Specialization
Ice Fusion
If Endless Winter was fused, whenever the defending hero adds a defending card to this chain link, create a Frostbite token under their control.
If Endless Winter hits a hero, until the end of their next turn, whenever they activate an ability, create a Frostbite token under their control.

energetic_impact.text_zh: 当此牌与一张力量为6或更高的牌一起防御时，创造一个活力衍生物。
energetic_impact.text_en: When this defends together with a card with 6 or more {p}, create a Vigor token.

energy_of_the_audience.type_zh: 崇敬 守护者 行动·攻击
energy_of_the_audience.text_zh: 若你的生命低于其他每位英雄，每当你控制一个悬念光环，此牌获得+1力量。
energy_of_the_audience.text_en: If you have less {h} than each other hero, this gets +1{p} for each aura of suspense you control.

energy_potion.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：获得2点资源。

enflame_the_firebrand.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
enflame_the_firebrand.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动；控制3个或更多，本战斗链中你的攻击视为龙裔；控制4个或更多，此牌获得+2力量。
enflame_the_firebrand.text_en: When this attacks, if you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again, 3 or more, your attacks are Draconic this combat chain, 4 or more, this gets +2{p}.

engage_steel.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次剑攻击获得+3力量，以及“若此牌被战士牌防御，此牌获得+1力量。”
再动
engage_steel.text_en:
Your next sword attack this turn gets +3{p} and "If this is defended by a Warrior card, this gets +1{p}."
Go again

engaged_swiftblade.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次战士攻击获得+3力量，以及“若此牌被攻击行动牌防御，此牌获得再动。”
再动
engaged_swiftblade.text_en:

若你装备了一件基础头部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌被装备时，将你放逐区中的至多1张机械师行动牌置于你的牌库顶。
秘法屏障1
evo_recall.text_en:
If you have a base head equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this is equipped, put up to 1 Mechanologist action card from your banished zone on top of your deck.
Arcane Barrier 1

evo_scatter_shot.type_zh: 机械师 行动 装备·Evo 手臂
evo_scatter_shot.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础手臂装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
每有一位对手英雄，你的泰克洛爆能枪获得+1力量。
战痕
evo_scatter_shot.text_en:
If you have a base arms equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
Your Teklo Blaster gets +1{p} for each opposing hero.
Battleworn

evo_sentry_base_legs.text_zh:

evo_sentry_base_legs.text_en:

Battleworn

evo_shortcircuit.type_zh: 机械师 瞬间 装备·Evo 手臂
evo_shortcircuit.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础手臂装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌被装备时，对任意目标造成1点伤害。
秘法屏障1
evo_shortcircuit.text_en:
If you have a base arms equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this is equipped, deal 1 damage to any target.
Arcane Barrier 1

evo_smoothbore.type_zh: 机械师 行动 装备·Evo 手臂
evo_smoothbore.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础手臂装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
每回合一次瞬间——摧毁此牌之下的一张牌：你本回合的下一次武器攻击获得+1力量。
刃碎
evo_smoothbore.text_en:
If you have a base arms equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
Once per Turn Instant - Destroy a card under this: Your next weapon attack this turn gets +1{p}.
Blade Break

evo_speedslip.type_zh: 机械师 瞬间 装备·Evo 腿部
evo_speedslip.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础腿部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌被装备时，本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得推进。
秘法屏障1
evo_speedslip.text_en:
If you have a base legs equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this is equipped, the next attack action card you play this turn gets boost.
Arcane Barrier 1

evo_steel_soul_controller.type_zh: 机械师 行动 装备·Evo Base 手臂
evo_steel_soul_controller.text_zh:
若你装备了基础手臂装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌从一张不同名称的进化牌转化而来或转化而去时，你可以将你坟场中一张力量为6的攻击行动牌放入你牌库的从上往下第五张的位置。若那张进化牌是英雄，改为此效果触发两次。
淬炼
evo_steel_soul_controller.text_en:
If you have base arms equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this transforms from or into an Evo with a different name, you may put an attack action card with 6{p} from your graveyard into your deck fifth from the top. If that Evo is a hero, instead this triggers twice.
Temper

evo_steel_soul_memory.type_zh: 机械师 行动 装备·Evo Base 头部
evo_steel_soul_memory.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础头部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌从一张不同名称的进化牌转化而来或转化而去时，你的英雄直到回合结束获得+1智力。若那张进化牌是英雄，改为此效果触发两次。
淬炼
evo_steel_soul_memory.text_en:
If you have a base head equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this transforms from or into an Evo with a different name, your hero gets +1{i} until end of turn. If that Evo is a hero, instead this triggers twice.
Temper

evo_steel_soul_processor.type_zh: 机械师 行动 装备·Evo Base 胸部
evo_steel_soul_processor.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础胸部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌从一张不同名称的进化牌转化而来或转化而去时，获得3点资源。若那张进化牌是英雄，改为此效果触发两次。
淬炼
evo_steel_soul_processor.text_en:
If you have a base chest equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this transforms from or into an Evo with a different name, gain {r}{r}{r}. If that Evo is a hero, instead this triggers twice.
Temper

evo_steel_soul_tower.type_zh: 机械师 行动 装备·Evo Base 腿部
evo_steel_soul_tower.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础腿部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌从一张不同名称的进化牌转化而来或转化而去时，获得1个行动点。若那张进化牌是英雄，改为此效果触发两次。
淬炼
evo_steel_soul_tower.text_en:
If you have a base legs equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this transforms from or into an Evo with a different name, gain 1 action point. If that Evo is a hero, instead this triggers twice.
Temper

evo_tekloscope.type_zh: 机械师 行动 装备·Evo 头部
evo_tekloscope.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础头部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
你的泰克洛爆能枪攻击可以以任意对手英雄为目标。
战痕
evo_tekloscope.text_en:
If you have a base head equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
Your Teklo Blaster attacks can target any opposing hero.
Battleworn

evo_thruster.type_zh: 机械师 行动 装备·Evo 腿部
evo_thruster.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础腿部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
每回合一次瞬间——摧毁此牌之下的一张牌：本回合你可以用目标武器额外攻击一次。
刃碎
evo_thruster.text_en:
If you have a base legs equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
Once per Turn Instant - Destroy a card under this: You may attack an additional time with target weapon this turn.
Blade Break

evo_whizz_bang.type_zh: 机械师 瞬间 装备·Evo 手臂
evo_whizz_bang.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础头部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌被装备时，至多1个目标攻击获得+1力量。
evo_whizz_bang.text_en:
If you have a base head equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this is equipped, up to 1 target attack gets +1{p}.

evo_zip_line.type_zh: 机械师 瞬间 装备·Evo 腿部
evo_zip_line.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础腿部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌被装备时，至多1个目标攻击获得再动。
evo_zip_line.text_en:
If you have a base legs equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this is equipped, up to 1 target attack gets go again.

evo_zoom_call.type_zh: 机械师 瞬间 装备·Evo 头部
evo_zoom_call.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础头部装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌被装备时，你可以放逐你手牌中的一张牌。若如此做，抽一张牌。
evo_zoom_call.text_en:
If you have a base head equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this is equipped, you may banish a card from you hand. If you do, draw a card.

excessive_bloodloss.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的红色牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。若其为红色，重复此过程一次。
excessive_bloodloss.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' red cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck. If it's red, repeat this process once.

expedite.text_zh:
推进
当此牌命中时，你可以将你手牌中一张费用为0或1的物品放入竞技场。
expedite.text_en:
Boost
When this hits, you may put an item with cost 0 or 1 from your hand into the arena.

expedition_to_azuro_keys.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以将一个金币指示物放在宝藏之岛上。
expedition_to_azuro_keys.text_en: When this attacks, you may put a gold counter on Treasure Island.

expedition_to_blackwater_strait.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以将一个金币指示物放在宝藏之岛上。
expedition_to_blackwater_strait.text_en: When this attacks, you may put a gold counter on Treasure Island.

expedition_to_dreadfall_reach.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以将一个金币指示物放在宝藏之岛上。
expedition_to_dreadfall_reach.text_en: When this attacks, you may put a gold counter on Treasure Island.

expedition_to_horizons_mantle.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以将一个金币指示物放在宝藏之岛上。
expedition_to_horizons_mantle.text_en: When this attacks, you may put a gold counter on Treasure Island.

expendable_limbs.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 防御反应
expendable_limbs.text_zh:
作为使用此牌的额外费用，随机放逐你手牌中的一张牌。
若以此方式放逐的是一张力量为6或更高的牌，在你的下一个行动阶段期间你可以从你的放逐区使用它。
expendable_limbs.text_en:
As an additional cost to play this, banish a random card from your hand.
If a card with 6 or more {p} is banished this way, you may play it from your banished zone during your next action phase.

explosive_growth.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
explosive_growth.text_zh:
大地融合
若爆炸性成长已融合，每当它造成伤害时，本战斗链中的攻击获得+1力量。
当你用爆炸性成长攻击时，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
explosive_growth.text_en:
Earth Fusion
If Explosive Growth was fused, whenever it deals damage, attacks gain +1{p} this combat chain.
When you attack with Explosive Growth, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

exposed.text_zh:
若你已被标记，你不能使用此牌。
目标攻击获得+1力量。
标记防御英雄。
exposed.text_en:
If you are marked, you can't play this.
Target attack gets +1{p}.
Mark the defending hero.

exposed_to_the_elements.text_zh:
大地和/或冰融合
若暴露于元素以一张大地牌融合，在目标装备上放置一个-1防御指示物。
若暴露于元素以一张冰牌融合，摧毁目标英雄控制的防御为0的一件装备，除非其支付2点资源。
exposed_to_the_elements.text_en:
Earth and/or Ice Fusion
If Exposed to the Elements was fused with an Earth card, put a -1{d} counter on target equipment.
If Exposed to the Elements was fused with an Ice card, destroy an equipment with 0{d} controlled by target hero unless they pay {r}{r}.

express_lightning.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
express_lightning.text_zh: 作为使用迅疾闪电的额外费用，你可以为你的英雄的灵魂充能。
express_lightning.text_en: As an additional cost to play Express Lightning, you may charge your hero's soul.

extinguish_the_flames.text_zh:
隐匿
契约——你受契约束缚以命中一位名为辛德拉的被标记英雄。每当你完成此契约时，抽一张牌。
extinguish_the_flames.text_en:
Stealth
Contract - You are contracted to hit a marked hero named Cindra. Whenever you complete this contract, draw a card.

exude_confidence.text_zh:
当散发自信没有被力量等于或高于它的牌防御时，本战斗链中防御英雄不能使用或启动瞬间和防御反应。
瞬间——支付3点资源：散发自信获得+2力量。仅当散发自信正在攻击时才能启动此异能。
exude_confidence.text_en:
While Exude Confidence isn't defended by a card with equal or greater {p}, the defending hero can't play or activate instants or defense reactions this combat chain.
Instant - {r}{r}{r}: Exude Confidence gains +2{p}. Activate this ability only while Exude Confidence is attacking.

eye_of_ophidia.text_zh:
传奇
当你将蛇神之眼资源时，占卜2。
eye_of_ophidia.text_en:
Legendary
When you pitch Eye of Ophidia, opt 2.

ez_sqeez_bookie_syndicate.text_zh: 直到回合结束，每当你攻击英雄时，与该英雄下注。胜者创造2个金币衍生物。
ez_sqeez_bookie_syndicate.text_en: Until end of turn, whenever you attack a hero, wager with them. The winner creates 2 Gold tokens.
